news.title: Kansas Board of Regents recognizes ‘outstanding contributions’ of six KU employees
news.summary_en: The board’s program recognizes faculty and staff at Kansas universities for their contributions to teaching, student success, research, institutional excellence and Kansas communities.

news.title: KU Kudos: Faculty and staff achievements, September 2026
news.summary_en: It’s time to celebrate Jayhawk colleagues’ achievements: KU News Service accepted submissions and combed websites, social media and newsletters for recent external honors and awards for current faculty and staff at the Lawrence, Edwards and Medical Center campuses and affiliates.

news.title: KU Marching Jayhawks to represent university in London at Union Jack Classic
news.summary_en: Members of the University of Kansas Marching Jayhawks will travel to London this month to represent KU at the Union Jack Classic, where the band will perform at the KU football game against Arizona State University on Sept. 19 at Wembley Stadium.

news.title: Four KU seniors to compete for Rhodes, Marshall, Churchill scholarships
news.summary_en: Four University of Kansas seniors — Saad Awan, Kaitlyn Carson, Katherine Goodwin and Jaden Huehl — have been endorsed for prestigious fellowships for study in the United Kingdom with the support of KU’s Center for Undergraduate Research & Fellowships.

news.title: KU Engineering’s Tiberti Lecture returns this fall with a focus on managing difficult conversations
news.summary_en: Aaron Mann, senior principal and chief legal officer at Terracon, will deliver the J.A. Tiberti Family Lecture at the University of Kansas School of Engineering at 2:30 p.m. Oct. 15 in the Beren Auditorium.

news.title: Linguistics experts decipher what a Kansas accent is or is not
news.summary_en: In a new article, Lacey Wade and Jeff Holliday, assistant professors of linguistics at the University of Kansas, reveal that Kansans associate Kansas speech with “unaccentedness,” while non-Kansans associate Kansas speech with Southern-accented voices.

news.title: Authors shed light on first-generation experience for higher ed professionals
news.summary_en: A book chapter co-written by University of Kansas researcher Dallas Doane documents the experiences of first-generation higher education professionals who transition to faculty roles while highlighting the strengths people in the experience naturally bring.

news.title: KU Architecture & Design Alumni Awards recognize 11 distinguished alumni
news.summary_en: The KU School of Architecture & Design has named recipients of its 2025 Architecture & Design Alumni Awards, recognizing graduates whose careers have advanced design, innovation and community impact.

news.title: 15 instructional faculty members promoted in past year
news.summary_en: Fifteen individuals at the University of Kansas Lawrence and Edwards campuses have earned instructional faculty promotions over the past year. “These educators represent some of the best in teaching and research excellence,” said Arash Mafi, chief academic officer, provost and executive vice chancellor.
